# How to prompt AI video models — Seedance 2.5, Kling 4, Veo 3.1 and Wan 3

**A shot list becomes the right model per shot, structured prompts with reference roles, locked audio and a QA check per clip.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_507022243812.webp" alt="One approved first frame animated by three video models side by side: a white supercar lifts off on jet thrusters over wet rails at night." width="480"></p>

How to prompt varg's video, image, voice and music models so shots come out right on the first or second take: the working loop (references, look bible, environment master, character sheets, approved stills, audio lock, animate, QA), which model for which shot (Seedance 2.5, Kling 4, Veo 3.1, Wan 3, Nano Banana 2.1, GPT Image 2.5, ElevenLabs v4, Lyria, lip sync), prompt anatomy for video, stills and edits, what @image1, @video1 and @audio1 references copy, dialogue and voice rules, a frame and audio QA checklist, and gotchas from paid runs. Use when someone asks to "prompt Seedance", write a Kling or Veo prompt, pick a "varg video model" or asks "which model", does "image to video" or "video to video", needs a "consistent character" or location, makes "storyboard stills" or key frames, wants dialogue or lip sync, or asks why a clip looks like AI slop, drifted or ignored the prompt.

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill varg-video-prompting                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills varg-video-prompting --agent github-copilot --scope user

```

## Ask your agent

- "Which model should I use for a 5-second close-up of a woman laughing in the rain? Write the prompt too"
- "Write a Seedance 2.5 prompt with @image1 as my character sheet ./sheet.png and three timed hard cuts"
- "My image-to-video clip drifted from the still and put a phone in her hand. Fix the prompt"
